prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate one wide opaque 2D fighting-game arena concept, HORIZON COLONY DEFENSE COURTYARD, specifically the Mass Effect 2 courtyard from the supplied actual gameplay screenshots, in the anti-aircraft defense battle area. Treat the two screenshots as strict reference for the architecture, materials and lighting. Preserve squat industrial gray-brown modular colony buildings with beveled panels, deep horizontal roof overhangs, rectangular gray utility containers in the rear, slim antenna towers, dry yellow grass patches and a few trees with muted ochre-yellow foliage visible above the buildings. Preserve the extremely recognizable late-afternoon orange-gold clouded sky, deep brown shadows and cream-colored ribbed metal walkway. Do not borrow Sanctuary from Mass Effect 3. Recompose into a clear side-on arena: a straight uninterrupted cream-gray metal combat walkway spans the full bottom 24 percent, flat and horizontal, with dry grass just BEHIND it. Buildings and containers form the middle distance, leaving a broad clear center for character silhouettes. Keep any walls, stairs, containers and railings behind the play strip. No giant cannon design invented beyond the screenshots: this is the courtyard beside the defense installation, not a close-up of an unspecified weapon. No extra structures, orbital ships or destruction. Remove all characters, husks, Praetorian, energy effects, projectiles, corpses, names, logos, watermarks, HUD and all text. No fighters. Detailed coherent videogame environment painting, clean material read, faithful Mass Effect 2 color treatment, wide landscape aspect ratio as supported, one scene not a collage. No transparent areas. No layer separation diagrams. This is a fighting composition adapted from the reference, not a claimed one-to-one game map.

prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one single wide opaque 2D fighting-game arena concept: the COLLECTOR BASE INTERIOR INFILTRATION WALKWAYS from MASS EFFECT 2, the first infiltration portion of the suicide mission, not the Collector Ship mission and not the Human Reaper boss chamber. Use the two supplied real gameplay screenshots as the authority for architecture, surface language, and palette even though they are low resolution. Preserve the dark olive-green and brown-black biomechanical walls, tall ribbed chitin-like vertical structural supports, densely layered rough organic-metal floor, restrained warm amber illumination inside narrow wall recesses, low rectangular organic-metal parapets and cool green-gray distant haze. The space should be ominous and immense but structurally consistent with the screenshots, with ribs rather than human industrial rivets or gothic church decorations. Adapt into a side-on 2D fighting arena, with a continuous straight level dark organic-metal walkway spanning the entire bottom 25 percent, completely clear and broad enough for two fighters. Put tall vertical ribs and recesses in the background and distant hazy structural openings between them, with low ledges behind the combat lane only. Keep a readable midground, controlled low-key lighting, enough soft cool light on the empty foreground to distinguish fighter silhouettes later. No new giant pod chamber, no Human Reaper, no skull motif, no human colonists, no people, Collectors, characters, creatures, vehicles, swarms, bodies, projectiles, HUD, watermarks, logos, text or labels. One cohesive detailed videogame background painting, not a texture sheet or collage. Wide landscape aspect ratio as supported, opaque background. Do not draw separate layers. This is a side-on concept adapted from limited visual references, not an exact geometric reproduction.
